description: Redux reducer module for managing the state of the right-hand sidebar (RHS) in the Mattermost web application, including selected posts, search parameters, UI states, and visibility flags.

methods.name: selectedPostId
methods.description: Reducer for the ID of the currently selected post in the RHS.

methods.name: selectedPostFocussedAt
methods.description: Reducer tracking the last focus time of a selected post.

methods.name: highlightedPostId
methods.description: Reducer for the ID of the highlighted reply post.

methods.name: filesSearchExtFilter
methods.description: Reducer for the extension filters used in file search within RHS.

methods.name: selectedPostCardId
methods.description: Reducer for the ID of the selected post card.

methods.name: selectedChannelId
methods.description: Reducer for the ID of the selected channel in RHS.

methods.name: previousRhsStates
methods.description: Reducer maintaining a history stack of RHS states.

methods.name: rhsState
methods.description: Reducer for the current RHS state (e.g., viewing a post, search, plugin).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Reducer for the size of the RHS sidebar.

methods.name: searchTerms
methods.description: Reducer for the current search terms in RHS.

methods.name: searchTeam
methods.description: Reducer for the team ID associated with RHS search.

methods.name: searchType
methods.description: Reducer for the type of search performed in RHS.

methods.name: pluggableId
methods.description: Reducer for the ID of the plugin currently active in RHS.

methods.name: searchResultsTerms
methods.description: Reducer for the search result terms in RHS.

methods.name: searchResultsType
methods.description: Reducer for the search result type in RHS.

methods.name: isSearchingFlaggedPost
methods.description: Flag indicating if flagged posts are being searched.

methods.name: isSearchingPinnedPost
methods.description: Flag indicating if pinned posts are being searched.

methods.name: isSidebarOpen
methods.description: Flag indicating if the RHS sidebar is open.

methods.name: isSidebarExpanded
methods.description: Flag indicating if the RHS sidebar is expanded.

methods.name: isMenuOpen
methods.description: Flag indicating if the RHS menu is open.

methods.name: editChannelMembers
methods.description: Flag for editing channel members in RHS.

methods.name: shouldFocusRHS
methods.description: Flag indicating if RHS should be focused.
